steps.message: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

Please solve this issue: Hi! I look after our city's Consul Democracy site. I'm not a developer: the
developer who built it has moved on, and I only know what they wrote down for
me. The app lives in `/app`, a Rails 8 app on PostgreSQL, and the development
database is the one our deploys migrate.

On the site citizens debate, vote in polls, take part in participatory budgets
and in legislation processes. They could also publish *citizen proposals*, and
the council has decided to retire them: the proposals themselves, the
notifications their authors sent to followers, the authors' dashboard with its
actions and administrator tasks, and the admin, moderation and management
screens around all of that. Legislation processes have proposals of their own
(`Legislation::Proposal`); those are a different thing and they stay. People
commented on citizen proposals, voted for and followed them, and the rest of
the site has to keep working.

I want citizen proposals gone from the app and from the database, including
whatever other parts of the database still point at them. I don't know how to
do that properly, so we'll do it together, one deploy at a time: you prepare a
deploy, I ship it, and I come back to you with the next step. Our hosting
person says it takes three deploys: first the code goes, then its tables and
columns, and the last one tidies up whatever is left. You won't remember our
earlier sessions, so keep notes in `docs/REMOVAL.md`: what you changed, what
has shipped and what is left for next time. When you start, read them first.

Our hosting person insists on two things. No downtime: while a new release
deploys and migrates, the servers of the previous release keep serving, so
every deploy has to run safely next to the one before it. And nothing leaves
the database without a copy: before a table or a column goes, dump what it
holds into a file under `db/`, and keep it. Please change nothing unrelated to
citizen proposals. We ship English and Spanish; the i18n spec keeps the English
strings honest, and the translators catch up on Spanish later.

The first two deploys are out: both are in production on every server, and the
site still works. Let's clean up whatever is left and be done with it.

{
  "returncode": 0,
  "output_head": "# Citizen Proposals Retirement Plan (`docs/REMOVAL.md`)

This document tracks the zero-downtime retirement of **citizen proposals** (`Proposal`), **proposal notifications** (`ProposalNotification`), **the authors' dashboard** (`Dashboard::*`, `Link`), and all admin, moderation, and management screens around them.

`Legislation::Proposal` (proposals belonging to collaborative legislation processes) is a separate feature and stays intact.

## Invariants Across All Deploys

- **Zero downtime**: Every deploy must run safely side-by-side with the release immediately before it while migrations run and app servers roll over.
- **Archive before removal**: Before any table, column, or citizen-proposal-linked row is removed from PostgreSQL, dump its contents into a file under `db/` and keep it in the repository.
- **Database target**: Deploys migrate `consul_development` (the development PostgreSQL database).
- **Scope and i18n**: Touch nothing unrelated to citizen proposals. Keep English locale files (`config/locales/en/*.yml` and `config/i18n-tasks.yml`) passing `spec/i18n_spec.rb`; Spanish translations catch up later.

---

## Status Summary

- **Deploy 1 — Remove application code and prepare models for schema changes**: **Shipped (in production on every server)**
- **Deploy 2 — Archive data, clean linked rows, and drop tables and columns**: **Prepared (ready to ship)**
- **Deploy 3 — Remove `ignored_columns` and transitional scopes/guards**: Pending (next / final session)

---

## Deploy 1 — Remove Application Code and Prepare Models (Shipped)

### Summary of What Shipped in Deploy 1

- Removed citizen proposal, proposal notification, author dashboard, and link models/mailers/libs (`Proposal`, `Proposal::Exporter`, `ProposalNotification`, `Dashboard`, `Dashboard::Action`, `Dashboard::AdministratorTask`, `Dashboard::ExecutedAction`, `Link`, `Linkable`, `EmailDigest`, `Dashboard::Mailer`).
- Removed public, admin, moderation, management, and GraphQL routes, controllers, views, components, helpers, JS/SCSS/image assets, and ML scripts for citizen proposals, proposal notifications, and the authors' dashboard while preserving `Legislation::Proposal` and admin/moderation/management root dashboards.
- Added `self.ignored_columns` on `MapLocation` (`proposal_id`), `Poll` (`related_type`, `related_id`), `Poll::Question` (`proposal_id`), `ActsAsTaggableOn::Tag` (`proposals_count`), and `User` (`email_digest`, `failed_email_digests_count`, `recommended_proposals`).
- Added transitional `default_scope`s and controller guards on polymorphic/shared models (`Comment`, `Notification`, `Activity`, `Flag`, `ActsAsVotable::Vote`, `Follow`, `ActsAsTaggableOn::Tagging`, `RelatedContent`, `Document`, `Image`, `Milestone`, `ProgressBar`, `SignatureSheet`, `MlSummaryComment`, `RemoteTranslation`, `SDG::Relation`, `Widget::Feed`, `WebSection`, `InstallationController`, `TopicsController`) so Release 1 ran safely while citizen-proposal rows were still present in PostgreSQL.

---

## Deploy 2 — Archive Data, Clean Linked Rows, and Drop Tables and Columns (Prepared)

### Why Deploy 2 Is Zero-Downtime Safe

- **Safe while Release 1 servers are running during and after `db:migrate`**: Release 1 servers have no code referencing the 7 dropped tables and already ignore all 8 dropped columns via `self.ignored_columns`, so active Release 1 workers never query removed tables or columns before, during, or after migration.
- **Safe if Release 2 servers boot before `db:migrate` completes**: Release 2 keeps `self.ignored_columns` and all transitional `default_scope`s/guards in place until Deploy 3, so Release 2 workers also handle both pre-migration and post-migration database states cleanly.

### What Changed in Deploy 2

#### 1. Archived All Retiring Tables, Columns, and Linked Rows Under `db/dumps/`

Before deleting any rows or dropping any columns/tables from `consul_development`, all retiring data was dumped as SQL into `db/dumps/` and kept in the repository:

- **Retiring tables**:
  - `db/dumps/proposals.sql` (12 rows)
  - `db/dumps/proposal_translations.sql` (12 rows)
  - `db/dumps/proposal_notifications.sql` (3 rows)
  - `db/dumps/dashboard_actions.sql` (3 rows)
  - `db/dumps/dashboard_executed_actions.sql` (2 rows)
  - `db/dumps/dashboard_administrator_tasks.sql` (1 row)
  - `db/dumps/links.sql` (0 rows)
- **Retiring columns on remaining tables**:
  - `db/dumps/map_locations_proposal_id.sql` (`map_locations.proposal_id` and full rows for the 2 proposal map locations)
  - `db/dumps/poll_questions_proposal_id.sql` (`poll_questions.proposal_id` and full row for question 1)
  - `db/dumps/polls_related_columns.sql` (`polls.related_type`, `polls.related_id`, and full row for proposal poll 1)

  belongs_to :remote_translatable, polymorphic: true

  validates :locale, inclusion: { in: ->(_) { RemoteTranslations::Caller.available_locales }}

  def enqueue_remote_translation
    remote_caller.delay.call
  end

  def self.for(*)
    resources_groups(*).flatten.select { |resource| translation_empty?(resource) }.map do |resource|
      new(remote_translatable: resource, locale: I18n.locale)
    end
  end

  def self.resources_groups(*args)
    feeds = args.find { |arg| arg&.first.class == Widget::Feed } || []

    args.compact - [feeds] + feeds.map(&:items)
  end

  def self.translation_empty?(resource)
    resource.class.translates? && resource.translations.where(locale: I18n.locale).empty?
  end

  def self.create_all(remote_translations_params)
    remote_translations_params.map do |remote_translation_params|
      new(remote_translation_params)
    end.reject(&:already_translated?).reject(&:enqueued?).each(&:save!)
  end

  def already_translated_resource
    if already_translated?
      errors.add(:locale, :already_translated)
    end
  end

  def enqueued?
    self.class.where(remote_translatable: remote_translatable,
                     locale: locale,
                     error_message: nil).any?
  end

  def already_translated?
    remote_translatable&.translations&.where(locale: locale).present?
  end

  def remote_caller
    @remote_caller ||= RemoteTranslations::Caller.new(self)
  end
end

module Attachables
  def imageable_attach_new_file(path, success: true)
    attach_new_file("Add image", "nested-image", "image", "Choose image", path, success)
  end

  def documentable_attach_new_file(path, success: true)
    attach_new_file("Add new document", "nested-documents", "document", "Choose document", path, success)
  end

  def attach_new_file(link_text, wrapper_id, field_class, input_label, path, success)
    click_link link_text

    within "##{wrapper_id}" do
      attach_file input_label, path
      within ".#{field_class}-fields" do
        expect(page).to have_css "progress[value='100']"

        if success
          expect(page).to have_css "progress.complete"
        else
          expect(page).to have_css "progress.errors"
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def admin_section?(path)
    path.starts_with?("/admin/")
  end

  def management_section?(path)
    path.starts_with?("/management/")
  end

  def edit_path?(path)
    path.ends_with?("/edit")
  end

  def fill_in_required_fields(factory, path)
    return if edit_path?(path)

    case factory
    when :budget then fill_in_budget
    when :budget_investment then fill_in_budget_investment
    end
  end

  def attachable_path_for(factory, attachable)
    case factory
    when :budget then new_admin_budgets_wizard_budget_path
    when :budget_investment
      [
        new_budget_investment_path(budget_id: attachable.budget_id),
        new_management_budget_investment_path(budget_id: attachable.budget_id)
      ].sample
    when :future_poll_question_option then new_admin_option_image_path(option_id: attachable.id)
    end
  end

  def submit_button_text_for(factory, path)
    case factory
    when :budget then "Continue to groups"
    when :budget_investment then "Create Investment"
    when :dashboard_action then "Save"
    when :future_poll_question_option then "Save image"
    when :proposal
      if edit_path?(path)
        "Save changes"
      else
        "Create proposal"
      end
    end
  end

  def notice_text_for(factory, path)
    case factory
    when :budget then "New participatory budget created successfully!"
    when :budget_investment then "Budget Investment created successfully."
    when :dashboard_action then "Action created successfully"
    when :future_poll_question_option then "Image uploaded successfully"
    when :proposal
      if edit_path?(path)
        "Proposal updated successfully"
      else
        "Proposal created successfully"
      end
    end
  end
end

module Ahoy
  class Chart
    attr_reader :event_name
    delegate :count, to: :records
    delegate :t, to: "ApplicationController.helpers"

    def initialize(event_name)
      @event_name = event_name
    end

    def self.active_event_names
      event_names_with_collections.select { |name, collection| collection.any? }.keys.sort_by do |event_name|
        new(event_name).title
      end
    end

    def self.event_names_with_collections
      {
        budget_investment_created: Budget::Investment.with_hidden,
        debate_created: Debate.with_hidden,
        legislation_annotation_created: Legislation::Annotation.with_hidden,
        legislation_answer_created: Legislation::Answer.with_hidden,
        level_3_user: User.with_hidden.level_three_verified
      }
    end

    def self.active_events_data_points
      Ahoy::DataSource.build do |data_source|
        active_event_names.map { |event_name| new(event_name) }.each do |chart|
          data_source.add chart.title, chart.data
        end
      end
    end

    def data_points
      Ahoy::DataSource.build do |data_source|
        data_source.add title, data
      end
    end

    def title
      t("admin.stats.graph.#{event_name}")
    end

    def data
      records_by_day.count
    end

    private

      def records
        case event_name.to_sym
        when :budget_investment_supported
          Vote.where(votable_type: "Budget::Investment")
        when :visits
          Visit.all
        else
          self.class.event_names_with_collections[event_name.to_sym]
        end
      end

      def records_by_day
        raise "Unknown event #{event_name}" unless records.respond_to?(:group_by_day)

        records.group_by_day(date_field)
      end

      def date_field
        if event_name.to_sym == :level_3_user
          :verified_at
        else
          :created_at
        end
      end
  end
end

cd /app && cat <<'EOF' > docs/REMOVAL.md
# Citizen Proposals Retirement Plan (`docs/REMOVAL.md`)

This document tracks the zero-downtime retirement of **citizen proposals** (`Proposal`), **proposal notifications** (`ProposalNotification`), **the authors' dashboard** (`Dashboard::*`, `Link`), and all admin, moderation, and management screens around them.

`Legislation::Proposal` (proposals belonging to collaborative legislation processes) is a separate feature and stays intact.

## Invariants Across All Deploys

- **Zero downtime**: Every deploy must run safely side-by-side with the release immediately before it while migrations run and app servers roll over.
- **Archive before removal**: Before any table, column, or citizen-proposal-linked row is removed from PostgreSQL, dump its contents into a file under `db/` and keep it in the repository.
- **Database target**: Deploys migrate `consul_development` (the development PostgreSQL database).
- **Scope and i18n**: Touch nothing unrelated to citizen proposals. Keep English locale files (`config/locales/en/*.yml` and `config/i18n-tasks.yml`) passing `spec/i18n_spec.rb`; Spanish translations catch up later.

---

## Status Summary

- **Deploy 1 — Remove application code and prepare models for schema changes**: **Shipped (in production on every server)**
- **Deploy 2 — Archive data, clean linked rows, and drop tables and columns**: **Shipped (in production on every server)**
- **Deploy 3 — Final cleanup of `ignored_columns`, transitional scopes/guards, and remaining dead assets/locales**: **Prepared (ready to ship — final deploy; nothing left afterwards)**

---

## Deploy 1 — Remove Application Code and Prepare Models (Shipped)

### Summary of What Shipped in Deploy 1

- Removed citizen proposal, proposal notification, author dashboard, and link models/mailers/libs (`Proposal`, `Proposal::Exporter`, `ProposalNotification`, `Dashboard`, `Dashboard::Action`, `Dashboard::AdministratorTask`, `Dashboard::ExecutedAction`, `Link`, `Linkable`, `EmailDigest`, `Dashboard::Mailer`).
- Removed public, admin, moderation, management, and GraphQL routes, controllers, views, components, helpers, JS/SCSS/image assets, and ML scripts for citizen proposals, proposal notifications, and the authors' dashboard while preserving `Legislation::Proposal` and admin/moderation/management root dashboards.
- Added `self.ignored_columns` on `MapLocation` (`proposal_id`), `Poll` (`related_type`, `related_id`), `Poll::Question` (`proposal_id`), `ActsAsTaggableOn::Tag` (`proposals_count`), and `User` (`email_digest`, `failed_email_digests_count`, `recommended_proposals`).
- Added transitional `default_scope`s and controller guards on polymorphic/shared models (`Comment`, `Notification`, `Activity`, `Flag`, `ActsAsVotable::Vote`, `Follow`, `ActsAsTaggableOn::Tagging`, `RelatedContent`, `Document`, `Image`, `Milestone`, `ProgressBar`, `SignatureSheet`, `MlSummaryComment`, `RemoteTranslation`, `SDG::Relation`, `Widget::Feed`, `WebSection`, `InstallationController`, `TopicsController`) so Release 1 ran safely while citizen-proposal rows were still present in PostgreSQL.

---

## Deploy 2 — Archive Data, Clean Linked Rows, and Drop Tables and Columns (Shipped)

### Summary of What Shipped in Deploy 2

- **Archived retiring tables, columns, and linked rows under `db/dumps/`**:
  - Retiring tables: `proposals.sql` (12 rows), `proposal_translations.sql` (12 rows), `proposal_notifications.sql` (3 rows), `dashboard_actions.sql` (3 rows), `dashboard_executed_actions.sql` (2 rows), `dashboard_administrator_tasks.sql` (1 row), `links.sql` (0 rows).
  - Retiring columns: `map_locations_proposal_id.sql`, `poll_questions_proposal_id.sql`, `polls_related_columns.sql`, `tags_proposals_count.sql`, `users_proposal_columns.sql`.
  - Linked records: `citizen_proposal_linked_records.sql` (full `INSERT` dumps across `communities`, `topics`, `polls` and dependent poll tables, `comments` and `comment_translations`, `votes`, `flags`, `follows`, `notifications`, `activities`, `taggings`, `related_contents` and `related_content_scores`, `map_locations`, `web_sections`, `settings`, and pre-update English `site_customization_page_translations`).
- **Migrated `consul_development` and updated `db/schema.rb` (`version: 2026_11_20_180100`)**:
  - `db/migrate/20261120180000_archive_and_clean_citizen_proposals.rb` archived retiring data, deleted citizen-proposal-linked rows in dependency order, stripped citizen-proposal bullets and shortcut `2` from English custom pages, and recalculated `users.notifications_count` and `tags.taggings_count`.
  - `db/migrate/20261120180100_drop_citizen_proposals_tables_and_columns.rb` removed foreign keys, dropped the 8 citizen-proposal columns (`map_locations.proposal_id`, `poll_questions.proposal_id`, `polls.related_type`, `polls.related_id`, `tags.proposals_count`, `users.email_digest`, `users.failed_email_digests_count`, `users.recommended_proposals`), and dropped the 7 citizen-proposal/dashboard/link tables (`dashboard_administrator_tasks`, `dashboard_executed_actions`, `dashboard_actions`, `links`, `proposal_notifications`, `proposal_translations`, `proposals`).

---

## Deploy 3 — Final Cleanup of Transitional Code and Remaining Leftovers (Prepared)

### Why Deploy 3 Is Zero-Downtime Safe

- **No schema changes or data migrations**: PostgreSQL is already at version `2026_11_20_180100` on every server, with all 7 tables, 8 columns, and citizen-proposal-linked rows removed.
- **Safe side-by-side with Release 2**: Release 2 servers (with `ignored_columns` and transitional `default_scope`s) and Release 3 servers (without them) query the exact same post-Deploy-2 tables, columns, and rows with identical behavior during rolling restart.

### What Changed in Deploy 3

#### 1. Removed All `self.ignored_columns` Declarations

- `app/models/map_location.rb`: removed `self.ignored_columns += ["proposal_id"]`
- `app/models/poll.rb`: removed `self.ignored_columns += %w[related_type related_id]`
- `app/models/poll/question.rb`: removed `self.ignored_columns += ["proposal_id"]`
- `config/initializers/acts_as_taggable_on.rb`: removed `self.ignored_columns += ["proposals_count"]` on `Tag`
- `app/models/user.rb`: removed `self.ignored_columns += %w[email_digest failed_email_digests_count recommended_proposals]`

#### 2. Removed All Transitional `default_scope`s and Controller Guards

- Removed transitional citizen-proposal `default_scope`s from `Comment`, `Notification`, `Activity`, `Flag`, `ActsAsVotable::Vote` (`config/initializers/vote_extensions.rb`), `Follow`, `ActsAsTaggableOn::Tagging` (`config/initializers/acts_as_taggable_on.rb`), `RelatedContent`, `Document`, `Image`, `Milestone`, `ProgressBar`, `SignatureSheet`, `MlSummaryComment`, `RemoteTranslation`, `SDG::Relation`, `Widget::Feed`, and `WebSection`.
- Removed transitional `.where.not(key: "process.proposals")` filter from `InstallationController#settings_feature_flags`.
- Removed transitional orphaned-community guard from `TopicsController#load_community`.

#### 3. Tidied Remaining Dead Assets, Helper, Spec Helpers, and English Locale Keys

- **JavaScript**: Removed stale `App.AdminDashboardActionsForm.initialize()` call and retired dashboard-poll cocoon modules (`options.js`, `questions.js`) from `app/assets/javascripts/application.js`, and deleted `app/assets/javascripts/options.js` and `app/assets/javascripts/questions.js`.
- **Stylesheets**: Removed `.proposal-dashboard > header` rules from `app/assets/stylesheets/layout.scss`, and removed `.dashboard-action-form`, `.proposal-retired`, and `.featured-proposals` selectors/rules from `app/assets/stylesheets/participation.scss` (keeping selectors shared with `Legislation::Proposal`).
- **Helpers & spec support**: Removed unused `render_destroy_element_link` (for retired `Link` nested forms) from `app/helpers/links_helper.rb`, removed `:dashboard_action` and `:proposal` branches from `spec/support/common_actions/attachables.rb`, and updated homepage assertion text in `spec/shared/system/mappable.rb`.
- **English locales**: Removed remaining citizen-proposal/dashboard/link-only keys (`activerecord.models.link` in `activerecord.yml`; `admin.stats.graph.proposal_created` in `admin.yml`; `dashboard.*`, `links.form.delete_button`, `links.nested_links`, `proposals.created`, `proposals.index.recommendations`, `proposals.index.search_form`, `proposals.index.title`, and `proposals.retire_form` in `general.yml`; `pages.help.proposals` in `pages.yml`) while preserving all keys shared with `Legislation::Proposal` and other features.

### What Is Left for Next Time

Nothing — once Deploy 3 ships, the retirement of citizen proposals is complete.
